[Prompt.toolResultPart({ id, name: \"Probe\", result: id, isFailure: !approved, providerExecuted: false })] : [])\\n+    ] }))\\n+  }\\n+  const model = await Effect.runPromise(LanguageModel.make({\\n+    generateText: (options) => { captured.push(options.prompt); return Effect.succeed([finish]) },\\n+    streamText: (options) => { captured.push(options.prompt); return Stream.fromIterable([finish]) }\\n+  }))\\n+  const layer = toolkit.toLayer({ Probe: ({ action }) => Effect.sync(() => { executed.push(action); return action }) })\\n+  async function request(prompt: Prompt.Message[]) {\\n+    return Effect.runPromise((method === \"generateText\"\\n+      ?
